title: Add econ-presets-importer CLI with deterministic defaults and weighted-sample generator
author: Ayesha Patel
release_notes: Introduce a stable CLI that imports tenant econ presets (YAML/JSON), generates deterministic tenant defaults using a weighted-sample generator, and outputs compact quantization profile templates. Adds telemetry hooks and docs. No breaking changes.
description:
Motivation: We frequently onboard tenants with custom budget constraints and workload samples. Operators repeatedly hand-edit presets which leads to inconsistent defaults and unexpected unit-econ regressions. This PR adds a lightweight CLI and library that imports preset bundles, validates them, and produces deterministic tenant defaults and compact quant profiles to seed Redwood defaults for Dedicated/Private deployments.

What this PR does: adds a new CLI (redwood-econ-import) and a small library module (redwood.econ.importer) that: 1) accepts preset bundles as YAML/JSON; 2) validates against the econ-presets schema; 3) computes deterministic defaults by combining historical workload signatures (sample weights) with tenant budget constraints; 4) synthesizes compact quantization profile templates (float16/8-bit presets) tuned for target tail latency; 5) emits a migration-ready JSON bundle and optionally applies to a tenant via an admin API.

Design notes and constraints: deterministic defaults are produced using a seeded weighted sampler so repeated runs with the same inputs are reproducible; the quant templates are small (<= 6 entries) and purposely conservative to avoid quality regressions; telemetry events are emitted at import/time-of-apply for auditing and rollback. CLI includes a --dry-run and --explain flags to aid reviews.

Review thread (highlights):
- Martin Schultz (reviewer) 2026-02-16: "Nice CLI shape. Two requests: 1) make seed exposure optional but logged, 2) ensure we don't allow applying to production tenants unless FF is on."
- Author (Ayesha) 2026-02-16: "Agree, made seed optional (--seed) and added explicit audit log + feature flag guard for apply operations. See commit 5/9."
- Yvonne Chen (reviewer) 2026-02-17: "Can we add a small calibration step to the quant templates that uses a representative sample? If not full calibration, at least a lightweight estimate of the max activations per layer so we avoid rare OOMs."
- Author (Ayesha) 2026-02-17: "Added a low-cost activation max estimator using sample statistics and clipped the quant template accordingly (commit 7/9). Tests included."
- Diego Ramirez (security reviewer) 2026-02-18: "Ensure CLI does not leak tenant secrets and admin API requires scoped token. Add a test for missing permissions."
- Author 2026-02-18: "Added token scoping check and doc note; CLI reads secrets only from KMS-backed env var and refuses plaintext tokens. Added test."

CI summary: initial CI run failed (lint error in main.go: unused import). Fixed in commit 3/9. Full unit test suite passed (pkg/econ/... tests). Integration pipeline with staging admin API passed on second run. Flaky test noted earlier (sampler_test) was stabilized by seeding the RNG in tests. Final CI: all checks green.

Merge notes: Squash-merged to main on 2026-02-21 by Martin Schultz. Changelog entry added in CHANGELOG.md under "Unreleased > Econ tooling". Feature is behind a runtime feature flag (econ_importer.enabled=false by default) and gated in the admin console.

Operational runbook (short):
- How to do a dry-run: redwood-econ-import --input presets.yaml --dry-run --explain
- Apply to tenant (admin): redwood-econ-import --input presets.yaml --apply --tenant-id T-123 --api-token <scoped-token> (requires econ_importer.enabled flag and audit approval)
- Rollback: admin console allows revert to previous preset bundle; telemetry has import_event with bundle_id to correlate.

Backward compatibility: None of the runtime hooks change default serving behavior unless the admin applies a preset. No changes to public SDKs.

Follow-ups (tracked):
- ENG-4410: add automatic sample extractor that generates small representative signature bundles from replay (next PR)
- ENG-1834: UI for guided import inside the admin console

Testing notes: added sample fixture bundles in testdata/, deterministic test seeds in sampler_test.go, and integration test run documented in docs/econ-importer.md.
